name: Cheese Soufflé
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)

ingredients.item: ¼ cup grated Old English or Young America cheese

steps: Melt butter, add flour, and when well mixed add gradually scalded milk.
Then add salt, cayenne, and cheese.
Remove from fire; add yolks of eggs beaten until lemon-colored.
Cool mixture, and cut and fold in whites of eggs beaten until stiff and dry.
Pour into a buttered baking-dish, and bake twenty minutes in a slow oven.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
